children: U.S. Senator Cynthia Lummis said that if the CLARITY Act does not pass in the current Congress, the next chance to reintroduce market structure legislation may not come until 2030. According to Foresight News, Lummis said passing the bill now would help avoid wasting years of jobs, investment, and tax revenue.

title: U.S. Senator Cynthia Lummis Says CLARITY Act Delay Could Push Market Structure Bill to 2030
